blocks.text: 将日志交付到 HTTP POST 端点的可注入输出，与相同版本的 `@migaia/log-host` 配合使用。批量、重试和超时由 host feature 提供，本包只执行一次请求。

请求体始终是 `{ "entries": [...] }`，每条 entry 的 error 字段由 host 的共享错误链投影处理。HTTP 不消费格式化文本，host 级格式对它跳过；请勿在 HTTP 的 features 中添加 format，创建时会以 host 的 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。默认 fetcher 是 `globalThis.fetch`；没有任何 fetcher 时工厂同步拒绝创建。
网络失败、429 和 5xx 可由 `retryFeature` 重试。严格解析的 `Retry-After` 覆盖下一次普通 backoff，并由 `maxRetryAfterMs` 限制。`attempts` 包含首次请求。
运行期交付错误进入 host 失败通道；不会让日志方法抛错或让 `flush` 拒绝。完整配置与错误边界见 使用指南。
安装本包与相同版本的 `@migaia/log-host`。每次 deliver 只做一次 POST；策略由 host feature 组合。
公开配置类型为 `IHttpPluginConfig`。url 原样传给 fetcher；缺省 fetcher 使用全局 fetch。注入函数接受 `(url, { method, headers, body, signal })` 并返回具有 ok/status/headers.get 的 Promise 结果。宿主超时和关闭通过 signal 传递；自定义 fetcher 应配合取消。
默认 Content-Type 为 application/json；headers 可覆盖，非空 authToken 再覆盖 Authorization 为 Bearer token。headers 在创建时复制。maxRetryAfterMs 默认为 30000，必须为有限非负数。

请求体始终为 `{ "entries": [...] }`。HTTP 调用 host 的共享 entry 投影；error 使用完整序列化错误链，保留 source/code/name/message/stack/cause/errors，排除 raw 和额外私有 Error 字段。普通业务字段保持原结构。HTTP 不消费格式化文本，跳过整个 host format 阶段；host 级 plain/pretty/JSON 格式不改变 wire。HTTP 的 output features 不能包含任何 format descriptor，否则创建时由 host 以 logging/INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。gate 与 entry 阶段照常执行。
网络错误、429 与 5xx 可重试，其它状态不重试。`attempts` 包含第一次请求。严格的 Retry-After 支持非负十进制秒数及三种 HTTP 日期；合法延迟覆盖普通 backoff 并按 maxRetryAfterMs 限制。没有 retryFeature 时不会隐式重试，没有 batchFeature 时不隐式聚合，没有 timeoutFeature 时不另设请求定时器。

`LOG_HTTP_ERROR_SOURCE` 为 logging.http；`LogHttpErrorCode` 包含 TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE、SERIALIZE_FAILED、DELIVERY_FAILED、INVALID_OPTION。缺少所有 fetcher、非法 maxRetryAfterMs 在创建时同步失败。运行期发送/序列化错误交给 host 失败通道，原生错误类型与 cause 保持可追溯；业务日志调用和 flush 不把交付失败重新抛出。交付失败与清理失败同时出现时，原交付错误排在错误链首位并用于重试分类；503 附带清理失败仍按配置重试。200 已成功而清理失败只报告一次 host 的 logging/DELIVERY_FAILED，不重发请求；timeout 自身错误也由 host logging 域负责。scheduler 必须在返回 receipt 之后才调用 callback。部署前应为 onFailure 提供业务需要的报告处理。
An injectable HTTP POST output for the matching `@migaia/log-host` version. Host features own batching, retry and timeout policy; this module performs one request attempt.

The wire body always remains `{ "entries": [...] }`. Entry error fields use the host's canonical error-chain projection. HTTP does not consume formatted text, so host formats are skipped. Adding a format to HTTP features is rejected at creation with the host INVALID_OPTION error. The output borrows `globalThis.fetch` unless a fetcher is supplied. Creation fails synchronously when neither exists.

Network failures, 429 and 5xx responses are eligible for `retryFeature`. Strictly parsed `Retry-After` advice overrides the next ordinary backoff and is bounded by `maxRetryAfterMs`. `attempts` includes the first request.
Runtime delivery failures enter the host failure channel. Logging methods do not throw and `flush` does not reject. See the usage guide for configuration and error boundaries.
Install this module with the same version of `@migaia/log-host`. Each delivery makes one POST; host features supply transport policy.

The public option type is `IHttpPluginConfig`. The URL is passed unchanged to fetcher, which defaults to global fetch. An injected function accepts `(url, { method, headers, body, signal })` and returns a Promise of an ok/status/headers.get response. Host timeout and shutdown propagate through signal; custom fetchers should cooperate with cancellation.

Content-Type defaults to application/json. Custom headers can override it; a nonempty authToken then overrides Authorization with Bearer token. Headers are copied at creation. maxRetryAfterMs defaults to 30000 and must be finite and nonnegative.

The body is always `{ "entries": [...] }`. HTTP uses the host's shared entry projection: errors retain source/code/name/message/stack/cause/errors while raw and private Error fields stay off the wire. Ordinary business fields retain their structure. HTTP does not consume formatted text and skips the entire host format phase. Host plain/pretty/JSON formats do not change the wire. HTTP output features cannot include any format descriptor: the host rejects it at creation with logging/INVALID_OPTION. Gate and entry stages still execute.

Network failures, 429, and 5xx are retryable; other statuses are not. Attempts include the first request. Strict Retry-After supports nonnegative decimal seconds and all three HTTP date forms. A valid delay overrides normal backoff and is clamped by maxRetryAfterMs. Without retryFeature there are no hidden retries; without batchFeature there is no implicit batching; without timeoutFeature there is no separate request timer.

`LOG_HTTP_ERROR_SOURCE` is logging.http. `LogHttpErrorCode` contains TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE, SERIALIZE_FAILED, DELIVERY_FAILED, and INVALID_OPTION. Missing fetch capabilities and invalid maxRetryAfterMs fail synchronously at creation. Runtime delivery/serialization failures reach the host failure channel with native error types and reachable causes. Business log calls and flush do not rethrow delivery failures. When delivery and cleanup both fail, the original delivery error comes first in the error chain and drives retry classification. A 503 with cleanup failures still follows the configured retry policy. Cleanup after a successful 200 is reported once as host logging/DELIVERY_FAILED and never replays the request; timeout errors also belong to host logging. A scheduler must return its receipt before invoking the callback. Install the onFailure reporting behavior required by your application.
